login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your audits and private reports.
login.invalid: Enter a valid email and your password.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Keep your audits and reports in one place.
register.weak: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
register.successDesc: If this email is new, a confirmation link is on its way to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentDesc: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link expires soon.
forgot.disabled: Password recovery is not configured in this environment.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password you haven't used before.
reset.weak: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
reset.successDesc: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.invalidDesc: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

callback.title: Completing sign-in
callback.failedDesc: The link may have expired or already been used. Try again.
callback.cancelledDesc: Google didn't complete the sign-in. You can try again.

unavailable.title: Sign-in unavailable
unavailable.desc: Authentication is not configured in this environment.

errors.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — we sent you a confirmation link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.recoveryExpired: This reset link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
